description.value: April's White Raven House is a waterfront guest house on northern Haida Gwaii in Old Massett, operated by Haida artist SG̱áana Jaad (April White), who also maintains an on-site gallery. The eight-room property sits on Masset Inlet with direct beach access and sweeping inlet views, offering a distinctly Haida cultural immersion. Touring cyclists would find it a compelling base for exploring North Beach, Tow Hill, ancient Haida villages, and the broader Gwaii Haanas region.
